#this code matches the MCI and DOC causes of death to the template by matching cause_general and cause_specific information (illness, drug, homicide, suicide, etc.) with a standardized, predicted final_cause
```{r libraries and data}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(reticulate)
py_require("pandas")
py_require("numpy")
py_require("openpyxl")
py_require("rapidfuzz")

template<-read_xlsx("cod_algorithm/a_02_COD Coding Input template.xlsx")
combined<-readRDS("~/Documents/GitHub/harmonized_carceral_mortality_data/data/a_02_mortality_data_post_processed/combined_mortality_data.rds")

```

fitting combined into template 1 where manner = COD general and cause= COD specific 
```{r fitting}
template1 <- combined %>%
  transmute(
    CASE_NUMBER = case_number,
    CAUSE_GENERAL = cause_general,

   CAUSE_SPECIFIC = coalesce(
      illspec,
      drugspec,
      homispec,
      suicspec,
      selfspec,
      accspec,
      otherspec, 
      cause_specific
    )
  )

#checking to make sure missingness pattern matches combined dataset 
template1%>%filter(is.na(CAUSE_GENERAL))%>%count() #7688
template1%>%filter(is.na(CAUSE_SPECIFIC))%>%count() #14214

#cleaning template to shorten cause_general SUICIDE description 
template1 %>%count(CAUSE_GENERAL, sort = TRUE)

template1$CAUSE_GENERAL[template1$CAUSE_GENERAL == "Suicide (e.g. hanging, knife/cutting instrument, intentional drug overdose) – describe events"] <- "Suicide"

#doing same for aids related illness
template1$CAUSE_GENERAL[template1$CAUSE_GENERAL == "Illness (exclude AIDS-related deaths), specify illness"] <- "Illness"

#looking at cause_specific and cleaning out Not Applicable 
template1 %>%count(CAUSE_SPECIFIC, sort = TRUE)
template1$CAUSE_SPECIFIC[template1$CAUSE_SPECIFIC == "Not Applicable"]<-NA

write_xlsx(template1, "z_archived/COD Coding Input template_1.xlsx")
```

```{python adaptedalgorithm str85 newcategories}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from rapidfuzz import fuzz
import re

# CONFIG

excel_file_name = "z_archived/COD Coding Input template_1.xlsx"
sub_sheet = "Sheet1"

keywords_excel = "a_03_final_kw_v1.xlsx"
kw_sub_sheet = "kw_icd_categories"

FUZZY_THRESHOLD = 85


# LOAD DATA

df = pd.read_excel(excel_file_name, sheet_name=sub_sheet, engine="openpyxl")

df["MANNER"] = df["CAUSE_GENERAL"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
df["CAUSE"] = df["CAUSE_SPECIFIC"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()


# LOAD KEYWORDS

kw_df = pd.read_excel(keywords_excel, sheet_name=kw_sub_sheet, engine="openpyxl")

def clean(col):
    return kw_df[col].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().str.strip().tolist()

od_keywords = clean("OVERDOSE KEYWORDS")
cold_keywords = clean("COLD KEYWORDS")
heat_keywords = clean("HEAT KEYWORDS")
suicide_keywords = clean("SUICIDE KEYWORDS")
homicide_keywords = clean("HOMICIDE KEYWORDS")
cardio_keywords = clean("CARDIOVASCULAR KEYWORDS")
resp_keywords = clean("RESPIRATORY KEYWORDS")
ca_keywords = clean("CANCERS KEYWORDS")
neuro_keywords = clean("NEUROPSYCHIATRIC KEYWORDS")
covid_keywords = clean("COVID-19 KEYWORDS")
comm_keywords = clean("COMMUNICABLE DISEASE KEYWORDS")
non_comm_keywords = clean("NONCOMMUNICABLE DISEASE KEYWORDS")
acc_keywords = clean("ACCIDENTAL KEYWORDS")
external_keywords = clean("INJURY KEYWORDS")
internal_keywords = clean("INTERNAL KEYWORDS")
unk_keywords = clean("UNDETERMINED")


# CAUSE/MANNER FALLBACK LOGIC

df["CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"] = df["CAUSE"]

missing_cause = df["CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"].eq("")

df.loc[missing_cause, "CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"] = df.loc[missing_cause, "MANNER"]

df["MANNER_FOR_CLASS"] = df["MANNER"]

missing_manner = df["MANNER_FOR_CLASS"].eq("")

df.loc[missing_manner, "MANNER_FOR_CLASS"] = df.loc[missing_manner, "CAUSE"]


# INITIAL FLAGS

flags = [
    "FINAL_OD",
    "FINAL_COLD",
    "FINAL_HEAT",
    "FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE",
    "FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE",
    "FINAL_CARDIO",
    "FINAL_RESP",
    "FINAL_CA",
    "FINAL_NEURO",
    "FINAL_COVID",
    "FINAL_COMM_DISEASE",
    "FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE",
    "FINAL_ACCIDENTAL_CAUSE",
    "FINAL_UNDETERMINED",
    "FINAL_EXTERNAL",
    "FINAL_INTERNAL"
]

for f in flags:
    df[f] = False


# HELPERS

def fuzzy(text, kws):
    if text == "":
        return False
    
    for kw in kws:
        if fuzz.token_set_ratio(text, kw) >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD:
            return True
    
    return False


# CAUSE groups 


cause_groups = {
    "FINAL_OD": od_keywords,
    "FINAL_COLD": cold_keywords,
    "FINAL_HEAT": heat_keywords,
    "FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE": suicide_keywords,
    "FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE": homicide_keywords,
    "FINAL_CARDIO": cardio_keywords,
    "FINAL_RESP" : resp_keywords,
    "FINAL_CA": ca_keywords, 
    "FINAL_NEURO": neuro_keywords,
    "FINAL_COVID": covid_keywords,
    "FINAL_COMM_DISEASE": comm_keywords,
    "FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE": non_comm_keywords,
    "FINAL_ACCIDENTAL_CAUSE": acc_keywords,
    "FINAL_EXTERNAL": external_keywords,
    "FINAL_INTERNAL": internal_keywords,
    "FINAL_UNDETERMINED" : unk_keywords
    
}


# CAUSE matching

df["MATCHED_KEYWORD"] = ""
df["MATCH_SCORE"] = np.nan
df["MATCH_TYPE"] = ""

for flag, kws in cause_groups.items():

    # exact matches
    for kw in kws:

        mask = (
            df["CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"]
            .str.contains(
                rf"\b{re.escape(kw)}\b",
                na=False,
                regex=True
            )
            &
            (df["MATCHED_KEYWORD"] == "")
        )

        df.loc[mask, flag] = True
        df.loc[mask, "MATCHED_KEYWORD"] = kw
        df.loc[mask, "MATCH_SCORE"] = 100
        df.loc[mask, "MATCH_TYPE"] = "Exact"


    # fuzzy fallback
    mask = (df[flag] == False) & (df["MATCHED_KEYWORD"] == "")

    for idx, text in df.loc[mask, "CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"].items():

        best_kw = None
        best_score = 0

        for kw in kws:
            score = fuzz.token_set_ratio(text, kw)

            if score > best_score:
                best_score = score
                best_kw = kw

        if best_score >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD:

            df.loc[idx, flag] = True
            df.loc[idx, "MATCHED_KEYWORD"] = best_kw
            df.loc[idx, "MATCH_SCORE"] = best_score
            df.loc[idx, "MATCH_TYPE"] = "Fuzzy"

# MANNER FLAGS

df["MANNER_HOMICIDE"] = df["MANNER_FOR_CLASS"].apply(
    lambda x: fuzz.token_set_ratio(x, "HOMICIDE") >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD
)

df["MANNER_SUICIDE"] = df["MANNER_FOR_CLASS"].apply(
    lambda x: fuzz.token_set_ratio(x, "SUICIDE") >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD
)

df["MANNER_ACCIDENTAL"] = df["MANNER_FOR_CLASS"].apply(
    lambda x: fuzz.token_set_ratio(x, "ACCIDENTAL") >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD
)

df["MANNER_NATURAL"] = df["MANNER_FOR_CLASS"].apply(
    lambda x: (
        fuzz.token_set_ratio(x, "NATURAL") >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD
        or 
        fuzz.token_set_ratio(x, "ILLNESS") >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD
    )
)

df["MANNER_UNKNOWN"] = df["MANNER_FOR_CLASS"].apply(
    lambda x: (
        fuzz.token_set_ratio(x, "UNKNOWN") >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD
        or
        fuzz.token_set_ratio(x, "UNDETERMINED") >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD
    )
)

# CAUSE STRUCTURE


df["FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE"] = (
    df["FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE"] |
    df["FINAL_CARDIO"] |
    df["FINAL_RESP"] |
    df["FINAL_CA"] |
    df["FINAL_NEURO"]
)

df["FINAL_COMM_DISEASE"] = (
    df["FINAL_COMM_DISEASE"] |
    df["FINAL_COVID"] 
)


df["FINAL_CAUSE_ACCIDENTAL"] = (
    df["FINAL_ACCIDENTAL_CAUSE"] | 
    df["FINAL_OD"] |
    df["FINAL_COLD"] |
    df["FINAL_HEAT"] 
)

df["FINAL_CAUSE_INTENTIONAL"] = (
    df["FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE"] |
    df["FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE"]
)


df["FINAL_EXTERNAL"] = (
    df["FINAL_EXTERNAL"] |  
    df["FINAL_CAUSE_ACCIDENTAL"] |
    df["FINAL_CAUSE_INTENTIONAL"]
)

df["FINAL_INTERNAL"] = (
    df["FINAL_INTERNAL"] |
    df["FINAL_COMM_DISEASE"] |
    df["FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE"]
)

df["CAUSE_UNDETERMINED"] = df["FINAL_UNDETERMINED"]



# MANUAL FLAG

df["MANUAL"] = ~(
    df["FINAL_EXTERNAL"] |
    df["FINAL_INTERNAL"] |
    df["FINAL_UNDETERMINED"]
)


# FINAL STRING OUTPUT COLUMNS

def get_final_manner(row):
    if row["MANNER_SUICIDE"]:
        return "SUICIDE"
    if row["MANNER_HOMICIDE"]:
        return "HOMICIDE"
    if row["MANNER_ACCIDENTAL"]:
        return "ACCIDENTAL"
    if row["MANNER_NATURAL"]:
        return "NATURAL"
    if row["MANNER_UNKNOWN"]:
        return "UNKNOWN"
    return "UNKNOWN"


def get_final_cause(row):

    # Intentional causes
    if row["FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE"]:
        return "HOMICIDE"

    if row["FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE"]:
        return "SUICIDE"

    # Accidental specific causes
    if row["FINAL_OD"]:
        return "OVERDOSE"

    if row["FINAL_COLD"]:
        return "COLD"

    if row["FINAL_HEAT"]:
        return "HEAT"

    # Disease
    if row["FINAL_CARDIO"]:
        return "CARDIOVASCULAR DISEASE"

    if row["FINAL_RESP"]:
        return "RESPIRATORY DISEASE"

    if row["FINAL_CA"]:
        return "CANCER"

    if row["FINAL_NEURO"]:
        return "NEUROPSYCHIATRIC ILLNESS"

    if row["FINAL_COVID"]:
        return "COVID-19"

    if row["FINAL_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "COMMUNICABLE DISEASE"

    if row["FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "NON-COMMUNICABLE DISEASE"

    # Broad fallback categories
    if row["FINAL_ACCIDENTAL_CAUSE"]:
        return "ACCIDENTAL"

    if row["FINAL_EXTERNAL"]:
        return "EXTERNAL"

    if row["FINAL_INTERNAL"]:
        return "INTERNAL"

    if row["FINAL_UNDETERMINED"]:
        return "UNDETERMINED"

    return "UNDETERMINED"

df["FINAL_MANNER_TEXT"] = df.apply(get_final_manner, axis=1)
df["FINAL_CAUSE"] = df.apply(get_final_cause, axis=1)

#LEVELS

#level1
def get_level1(row):
    if row["FINAL_EXTERNAL"]:
        return "External/Injury (Unnatural Death)"
    if row["FINAL_INTERNAL"]:
        return "Internal (Natural Death)"
    if row["FINAL_UNDETERMINED"]:
        return "Undetermined"
    return ""

#level2
def get_level2(row):

    if row["FINAL_CAUSE_ACCIDENTAL"]:
        return "Accidental"

    if row["FINAL_CAUSE_INTENTIONAL"]:
        return "Intentional"

    if row["FINAL_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "Communicable Disease"

    if row["FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "Non-Communicable Disease"

    if row["FINAL_UNDETERMINED"]:
        return "Undetermined"

    return ""

#level3
def get_level3(row):

    # External -> Accidental
    if row["FINAL_COLD"]:
        return "Cold-related death"

    if row["FINAL_HEAT"]:
        return "Heat-related death"

    if row["FINAL_OD"]:
        return "Overdose"

    if row["FINAL_ACCIDENTAL_CAUSE"]:
        return "Other Accidental"

    # External -> Intentional
    if row["FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE"]:
        return "Suicide"

    if row["FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE"]:
        return "Homicide"

    # Internal -> Communicable
    if row["FINAL_COVID"]:
        return "COVID-19"

    if row["FINAL_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "Other Communicable Disease"

    # Internal -> Non-Communicable
    if row["FINAL_CA"]:
        return "Cancer"

    if row["FINAL_CARDIO"]:
        return "Cardiovascular Disease"

    if row["FINAL_RESP"]:
        return "Respiratory Disease"

    if row["FINAL_NEURO"]:
        return "Neuropsychiatric Conditions"

    if row["FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "Other Non-Communicable Disease"

    # Undetermined
    if row["FINAL_UNDETERMINED"]:
        return "Undetermined"

    return ""

df["CLASS_LEVEL_1"] = df.apply(get_level1, axis=1)
df["CLASS_LEVEL_2"] = df.apply(get_level2, axis=1)
df["CLASS_LEVEL_3"] = df.apply(get_level3, axis=1)


df.to_excel("b_02_full_results_ICD.xlsx", index=False)


```
